# Switch NX2 - read at every start of the Satsuma GUI. The CLI frontend does not read it.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, %APPDATA%\satsuma\nx2_switches.txt (yours) wins over this one, so editing
# this file is never needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# Satsuma performance defaults, matching the established launcher.

# Per game: EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ_<program ID> overrides EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ for that game.
# Super Mario Bros. Wonder capped at 67.
EDEN_NX2_VSYNC_HZ_010015100B514000=67
